newsitem.title: USA: Shaman Pharmaceuticals expands Provir trial.
newsitem.headline: Shaman Pharmaceuticals expands Provir trial.

text.p: Shaman Pharmaceuticals Inc on Wednesday said it has expanded its Phase II program for Provir, an oral product for treating diarrhea, to include a pilot study that tests Provir for diarrhea in patients with AIDS.

Shaman also said it has completed the first in a series of double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase II studies for optimal dose information on Provir when it is used to treat watery diarrhea in travelers and non-specific diarrhea.
The results of this study form the basis for additional studies which the Company intends to initiate in April.
